The Investor Day will provide shareholders, investors and analysts with an update on Paladin's strategy, operational performance and growth outlook.

Following the transition of Langer Heinrich Mine (LHM) to full mining operations, the Investor Day will provide a deeper understanding of the quality, scale and strategic importance of the Patterson Lake South (PLS) Project. The program will highlight the progress made in de-risking the PLS Project, the pathway towards development, and its potential to create significant long-term value for shareholders.

The Investor Day will also showcase the broader exploration potential across Paladin’s portfolio, including opportunities within the PLS district, and further exploration upside beyond the current development plan.

Paladin Energy (ASX:PDN TSX: PDN OTCQX:PALAF) is a globally significant independent uranium producer with a 75% ownership of the world-class long-life Langer Heinrich Mine in Namibia. In Canada, Paladin Energy is progressing development of the Tier-1, high grade and shallow Patterson Lake South (PLS) Project in northern Saskatchewan and has an extensive portfolio of exploration assets within the province’s highly prospective Athabasca Basin and also at the Michelin project in Newfoundland and Labrador. In Australia, Paladin Energy owns uranium exploration assets in Queensland and Western Australia. Paladin Energy is committed to a sustainability framework that ensures responsible, accountable and transparent management of uranium resources - now and in the future. The Langer Heinrich Mine is delivering reliable uranium supplies to major nuclear utilities around the world, positioning Paladin Energy as a meaningful contributor to baseload energy provision in multiple countries and global decarbonisation, whilst unlocking the PLS Project to support future global nuclear energy expansion.
